programme.title: السر المدفون - Al Ser Al Madfoon
programme.desc: ‫‫تعود قضية شاب تم إعدامه بدم بارد إلى الظهور بقوة بعد مرور عشر سنوات عليها عندما يبحث والده الحزين جدا على فقدانه عن أي دليل بسيط يمكن أن يقوده إلى الحقيقة.‬‬ A 10-year-old case of cold-blooded dispatch of a young man comes to a head when his bereaved father searches for the slightest evidence that can lead to the truth.

programme.title: ناس الخير - Nas Al Kheer
programme.desc: ‫‫تسافر مجموعة من المتطوعين إلى مناطق مختلفة من المغرب لترميم الأماكن المهملة. يرمم هؤلاء المتطوعون هذه المواقع وينشرون فيها المحبة، في محاولة لرد الجميل للمجتمع.‬‬ A group of volunteers travel to different parts of Morocco to renovate neglected places. These volunteers restore and bring love to these sites in an attempt to pay back to society.

programme.title: آخر ثمن - Akher Thaman
programme.desc: ‫‫تدعو المضيفة خبراء للمساعدة في تحديد أسعار عدة تحف نادرة، ثم تعرضها على مجموعة من الأفراد المهتمين بشرائها.‬‬ The presenter invites experts to help determine the price of rare antiques and offers them to a group of people who are interested in buying them.

programme.title: صحتنا جميع - Sihtna Jamee
programme.desc: ‫‫يلقي خبراء ومتخصصون طبيون الضوء على مختلف المشكلات الصحية، ويناقشون تأثيراتها علاجاتها المحتملة وطرق الوقاية منها.‬‬ Medical experts and specialists shed light on various health issues and discuss their impact, possible cures and methods of prevention.

programme.title: خير لبلاد - Khayr Le Belad
programme.desc: ‫‫يسلط المضيف الضوء على المبادرات الرئيسية في مجال الزراعة التي تساعد المستثمرين على تحسين إنتاجيتهم وتعزيز الاستدامة.‬‬ The host sheds light on the key initiatives from the field of agriculture. Covering the important advances which will help investors improve their productivity and promote sustainability.

programme.title: مواهب في تجويد القرآن - Mawaheb Fi Tajweed Al Quran Al Kareem
programme.desc: ‫‫يتنافس فتيان وفتيات تتراوح أعمارهم بين العاشرة والثامنة عشر عاما مع بعضهم البعض ويرددون آيات من القرآن الكريم.‬‬ Girls and boys between ten and eighteen years old compete against each other and recite verses from the Holy Quran.

programme.title: شهيوات بلادي - Chhiwat Bladi
programme.desc: ‫‫تسافر المضيفة إلى العديد من المناطق في المغرب من أجل إعداد وصفات شهية، كما تسلط الضوء على الأطباق الأكثر شعبية في كل منطقة.‬‬ The host travels to various places in Morocco to prepare delicious recipes and highlight the region's most popular dishes.

programme.title: صباحيات 2M - Sabahiyat 2M
programme.desc: ‫‫يجيب أفراد فريق من الخبراء عن أسئلة المشاهدين في العديد من المواضيع مثل الصحة والجمال والموضة والطبخ.‬‬ A panel of experts answer viewers' questions on various topics such as health, beauty, fashion and cooking.

programme.title: كيف الحال - Keef Al Hal
programme.desc: ‫‫التعنق في المشاكل الصحية والطبية التي قد يكون لديها أثر على الحياة. يدعو المضيف أطباء ومتخصصين للحديث عن المشاكل الصحية وما يمكن فعله لتحسين الصحة.‬‬ Taking a deep dive into our health and medical issues that can affect use. programme.title: شار باساند - Shar Pasand
programme.desc: ‫‫يظهر فراسات علي للمجتمع واجهة نبيلة، لكنه يخفي في نفسه طبعا قاسيا حادا يجرح بعمق. تتسبب كلماته وأحكامه القاسية بانهيار العديد من الأسر وتشكك في كرامة سيدة وتترك جراحا لا تمحى.‬‬ Shar Pasand

programme.title: دوره ترجمة قرآن - Daura e Tarjuma e Quran
programme.desc: ‫‬ A Muslim cleric reads out verses from the Holy Quran and explains their meaning in a lucid manner to help devotees understand the scripture.

programme.title: داس إي بوكاري - Dars E Bukhari
programme.desc: ‫‫يشجع فريق التقديم المستمعين على عيش حياة ورعة، وكما يسلط الضوء على تعاليم وأقوال النبي محمد (صلى الله عليه وسلم).‬‬ The host encourages listeners to lead a devout life while illuminating the teachings and sayings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

programme.title: داستاك - Dastak
programme.desc: ‫‫تواجه السيدة المطلقة كيران الكثير من التحديات الاجتماعية الهائلة ووصمة العار القاسية التي يطلقها عليها المجتمع. مع ذلك وعلى الرغم كل هذه المعاناة، تكافح كيران من أجل تكوين هويتها الخاصة.‬‬ Kiran, a divorced woman, faces heavy societal stigma and challenges. However, despite the struggles, she fights back to forge her own identity.

programme.title: غود مورنينغ باكستان - Good Morning Pakistan
programme.desc: ‫‫تقدم نيدا ياسر آخر المستجدات الإخبارية من جميع أنحاء العالم، كما تقوم بمناقشة مشاكل المشاهدين والدردشة مع العديد من المشاهير.‬‬ Host Nida Yasir provides the latest happenings from all over the world, discusses the problems of the viewers and chats with various celebrities.

programme.title: بولبولاي - Bulbulay
programme.desc: ‫‫ينتقل نبيل ومحمود للعيش في منزل يملكه شخص آخر، ولكن تبدأ الفوضى والمشاكل عندما تقرر العروس الهاربة خوبسورات العيش معهما وتزوره والدته ممتاز.‬‬ Nabeel and Mehmood slyly move into a flat owned by someone else. However, chaos ensues for Nabeel when Khoobsurat, a runaway bride, decides to stay with them and his mother, Mumtaz, comes visiting.

programme.title: مادافا - Madawa
programme.desc: ‫‫تترك الفتاة اليتيمة الصغيرة أيمان في رعاية جدتها بعد زواج والدتها الطموحة. نتيجة لذلك، تسعى أيمان جاهدة للتغلب على مصاعب الحياة التي تواجهها.‬‬ Aiman, orphaned young, is left with her grandmother when her ambitious mother remarries. Consequently, she strives to overcome her hardships.

programme.desc: ‫‬ Sazawaar

programme.desc: ‫‫تتغير حياة زيبا عندما تكتشف أن الرجل الذي وثقت به قد لا يكون هو الرجل الحقيقي. ومع تغير سلوكه، تجد زيبا نفسها مضطرة للتعامل مع ضغوط عائلية وتباعد عاطفي وغير ذلك.‬‬ Kafeel

programme.title: العاصوف الموسم 1 الحلقة 1 - Al Asouf Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: في ظل التحولات الهامة التي بدأت في البزوغ منذ سبعينيات القرن الماضي وكان لها الأثر في تغيير المجتمع السعودي ككل، تنقلب حياة عائلة الطيان رأساً على عقب بعد أن تأوي طفلاً رضيعاً وجده الإمام محمد الطيان متروكاً عند باب المسجد. Amidst the historical turning points that took place in the Saudi society in the 70s, the Al Tayans’ lives take a turn after Imam Mohamad Al Tayan decides to take in an infant left at the doorstep of the mosque.

programme.desc: مقابلات مطولة تسلط الضوء على شخصيات تاريخية ومعاصرة وأبرز إنجازاتها. In-depth interviews highlighting historical and modern figures and their key achievements.

programme.title: عبداوي - Abdawy
programme.desc: سلسلة وثائقية تستكشف العلاقة العميقة بين الفنان محمد عبده وجمهوره المتنوع من خلال سلسلة من المقابلات واللقطات الأرشيفية، كما تقدم نظرة فريدة على التأثير البالغ لأغانيه على حياة محبيه الأوفياء. Through interviews and archival footage, the docuseries highlights the deep relationship Mohammed Abdu has with his audience, and how his music affects his loyal fans.

programme.title: قصائد وقارات - Qasa'ed Wa Qarrat
programme.desc: من أرض المعلقات، المملكة العربية السعودية، يناقش البرنامج ماهية الشعر على مدار التاريخ الإنساني، ومراحل تطوره في مختلف أنحاء العالم والتفاعل بين التجربة الإنسانية والتحديث الشعري. From the land of the Mu’allaqat, Saudi Arabia, the programme explores the essence of poetry throughout history, its evolution across the world, and the constant interplay between human experience and modernisation.

programme.title: فاكهة الجنة - Fakihat Al Jannah
programme.desc: برنامج أدبي يسلط الضوء على فاكهة واحدة في كل حلقة، بدءا من منشأ رمزيتها، مرورا بذكرها في الأساطير، وصولا إلى مكانتها في الوجدان المعاصر. A literary programme that spotlights a fruit each episode, tracing its symbolic origins, its presence in myths, and its place in contemporary culture.

programme.title: نجاحات سعودية موسم 2 حلقة 1 - Najahat Saudia Season 2 Episode 1
programme.desc: نظرة على أهم الشركات السعودية التي غيرت عالم الأعمال وساهمت بتقدم هائل لاقتصاد المملكة. A look at the Saudi companies that revolutionized the world of business and drove the Kingdom’s national economy forward.

programme.title: مرايا 98 الحلقة 22 - Maraya 98 Episode 22
programme.desc: يقوم النجم الكوميدي الساخر ياسر العظمة ومجموعة من أهم ممثلي سوريا بتصوير الواقع الاجتماعي في العالم العربي. Syrian satirical comedy star Yasser Al Azmeh and Syria’s top actors depict social problems the Arab world can relate to.

programme.title: وينك؟ - Waynak?
programme.desc: يستضيف معد ومقدم البرامج محمد الخميسي شخصيات بارزة في المجالات الفنية والسياسية والأدبية والرياضية غابت مؤخرا عن الظهور الإعلامي. Mohammed Al-Khamisi hosts prominent figures in the fields of arts, sports, politics, and literature who have been away from the screen lately.

programme.desc: يناقش بودكاست 1949 مواضيع ثقافية بقوالب متنوعة تعكس ما يدور في القطاع الثقافي السعودي بمختلف قطاعاته الفرعية، وفي كل حلقة يتم مناقشة موضوع ينتمي لأحد هذه القطاعات مع ناقد متخصص. Podcast 1949 delves into cultural topics across the Kingdom's culture sector, hosting professionals as they critique themes within the division.

programme.title: لامية العرب موسم 1 حلقة 9 - Lamiyyat Al Arab Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: يقوم الخبير في صناعة الوثائقيات عيد اليحيى بالكشف عن جوهر لامية العرب وبيوتها من أرض نشأتها إلى القصص التي ترويها. Documentary giant Eid Al-Yehya unpacks the essence of Lamiyyat al-'Arab, verse-by-verse, from its origins to the stories it tells.

التجارة الآسيوية - The Asia Trade - Episode 433
programme.desc:
برنامج متخصص يستعرض أبرز التطورات الاقتصادية والتجارية في قارة آسيا، مركزًا على الاتجاهات المستقبلية وفرص الاستثمار في أسواقها المتنوعة. من خلال تحليلات دقيقة وحوارات مع خبراء في الاقتصاد والتجارة، يقدم البرنامج رؤى معمقة حول تأثيرات التحولات الاقتصادية على الاقتصاد العالمي وكيفية استفادة الشركات والمستثمرين من هذه الفرص.
A Bloomberg show exploring Asia's impact on global trade through economic trends, policy insights, and market shifts. Featuring expert analysis and interviews, to understand the forces shaping Asia's trade landscape and its global influence.

ألوان الشرق - Alwan Asharq - Episode 1918
programme.desc: برنامج إخباري بصري مميز، يقدم تجربة إعلامية ديناميكية تجمع بين التحليل العميق والأسلوب البصري الإبداعي. تنطلق حلقاته بإيقاع اللون الأحمر، الذي يرمز إلى القضايا السياسية الساخنة، ثم تتنقل بسلاسة بين مجموعة من الألوان التي تعكس مختلف المجالات التي تهم المواطن العربي. يغطي البرنامج أبرز المستجدات في الاقتصاد، حيث يستعرض التغيرات في الأسواق والاستثمارات، إلى جانب القضايا الاجتماعية التي تؤثر على المجتمعات العربية. كما يتناول آخر تطورات الرياضة، والابتكارات التكنولوجية، والاكتشافات العلمية، والتحديثات الصحية، بالإضافة إلى لمسات من عالم الفنون والثقافة. بأسلوب تفاعلي حيوي، يقدم ألوان الشرق تحليلات شاملة لكل ملف، مع استضافة خبراء ومحللين لإثراء النقاش، مما يجعله وجهة إخبارية متكاملة للمشاهدين الراغبين في متابعة الأحداث بأسلوب جديد ومبتكر. A colorful visual news magazine, where red represents politics. Various colors and topics are presented including socio-economic issues, sports, technology, science, health, art and culture.

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح279 : ‫تسعى معلمة عظيمة وأم مخلصة في نفس الوقت جاهدة للتوفيق بين دوريها المتطلبين بينما تتوق إلى الحب الذي تستحقه بجدارة.‬‬ S1 , E279 : While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.

programme.title: تشيريكوم تاليكا - Chirikkum Thalika
programme.desc: ‫م2 ، ح35 : ‫مجموعة شاملة من أفضل المشاهد الكوميدية من مختلف الأفلام المالايالامية التي تضم ممثلين وممثلات مشهورين.‬‬ S2 , E35 : A comprehensive compilation of some of the best rib-tickling comedy scenes from various Malayalam movies featuring renowned actors and actresses.

programme.title: كاناكام كاميني كالام - Kanakam Kaamini Kalaham
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم بافيتران بإهداء هاريبريا قلادة ذهبية في محاولة أخيرة لإنقاذ زواجه. مع ذلك، تعم الفوضى عندما تسرق تلك القلادة وتبدأ مجموعة من الغرباء في البحث عن الجاني.‬‬ As a last-ditch effort to save his marriage, Pavithran gifts Haripriya a gold necklace. Mayhem ensues when the jewellery gets stolen and a set of strangers gets invested in finding the culprit.

programme.title: أبراهام أوزلر - Abraham Ozler
programme.desc: ‫‬ Seasoned cop Abraham Ozler delves into an enigmatic cold case, sparking a relentless pursuit of a cunning serial killer.

programme.title: كيشو إي فيدينتي نادان - Keshu Ee Veedinte Nadhan
programme.desc: ‫‫تنقلب حياة السائق العادي كيشو رأسا على عقب عندما يربح بطاقة يانصيب بقيمة ١٢ كرور، وبناء على ذلك يتم اختبار أخلاقه.‬‬ The life of an ordinary driver Keshu turns upside down when he wins a lottery worth 12 crores but his morality gets tested.

programme.title: ناتوراجافو - Natturajavu
programme.desc: ‫‫ينحدر تشارلي من أسرة غنية، لكنه يضطر إلى تحمل ذنوب وأخطاء والده عديم الضمير. يقرر كارنان، المحكوم عليه بالسجن، تصفية بعض الحسابات القديمة مع تشارلي.‬‬ Pulikkattil, an affluent family man, is forced to bear the brunt and burden of his late father's unscrupulous past. Now, Karnan, a jail convict, decides to settle some old scores with him.

programme.title: تو كنتريز - Two Countries
programme.desc: ‫‫يحيك أولاس مؤامرة للزواج من سيمران، وهي امرأة من ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، لكي يتجنب سداد الديون، لكنه يواجه تعقيدات عندما تدخل المرأة الثرية المدمنة على الكحول لايا إلى حياته، مما يقلب مخططاته رأسا على عقب.‬‬ Ullas schemes to marry Simran, woman with a disability, to avoid repaying a debt, but faces complications when Laya, a wealthy alcoholic, enters his life, turning his plans upside down.

programme.title: ريتيرن أوف ذا دراغون - Return Of The Dragon
programme.desc: ‫‫بعد انفصال عاطفي مؤسف، يتخلى طالب جامعي عن دراسته ليرتكب احتيالا ماليا، لكن مسعاه الجديد يضعه في موقف صعب.‬‬ Reeling from a sad breakup, a college student gives up on his studies to commit financial fraud. However, his new endeavour puts him in a difficult spot.

programme.title: فامنبورم بس روت - Vamanapuram Bus Route
programme.desc: ‫‫يتم إرسال محصل الحافلة جوني إلى منطقة فامنبورم لإلغاء رحلة حافلة، حيث يلتقي ويقع في حب ابنة مديره في العمل المخطوبة. يصبح جوني الآن على مفترق طرق.‬‬ Johnny, a bus conductor, is sent to Vamanapuram to clear a bus route, where he falls in love with his boss's daughter, who is already engaged.

programme.title: رد ساليوت - Red Salute
programme.desc: ‫‫يتشاجر مجموعة من السياسيين الفاسدين للاستحواذ على قصر قديم، ولكن سرعان ما تنقلب الأمور رأسا على عقب عندما تحكم المحكمة لصالح ميثران وجوزيف.‬‬ A group of corrupt politicians fight to acquire an old palace. However, things take a turn when the court rules in favour of Mithran and Joseph.

programme.title: شرلوك تومز - Sherlock Toms
programme.desc: ‫‫يقرر ضابط مصلحة الضرائب استخدام براعته التحليلية في التحقيق في عملية إجرامية واسعة النطاق، متبعا أسلوب شرلوك هولمز.‬‬ Inspired by Sherlock Holmes, an IRS officer, resolves to employ his analytical prowess in tackling an extensive criminal operation.

programme.title: برامايوغم - Bramayugam
programme.desc: ‫‫خلال القرن السابع عشر، يهرب مغن شعبي في ولاية كيرلا من العبودية، ويكتشف قصرا، حيث يلتقي بطاه غامض وسيد ذا سطوة، مما يطلق سلسلة من الأحداث التي تغير حياته.‬‬ A folk singer in 17th-century Kerala flees slavery and discovers a mansion. Inside, he encounters an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, setting in motion a chain of events that changes his life.

programme.title: باهوبالي ٢: ذا كونكلوجن - Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم ماهيندرا باهوبالي بحشد جيش لهزيمة بهالا ديفا وتحرير والدته من أسره بعد اكتشافه أن والده قتل بوحشية على يد بهالا ديفا.‬‬ After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

programme.title: فازونور - Vazhunnor
programme.desc: ‫‫يقود تيفاكاتو أفاراتشان وأبناؤه الستة إمبراطورية قوية في تجارة الأعمال، لكن التوترات تتصاعد عندما تصل مجموعة منافسة تهدد إرثهم والسلام بينهم.‬‬ Thevakattu Avarachan and his six sons lead a powerful business empire, but tensions rise when a rival group arrives, threatening their legacy and peace.

programme.title: أرافيندانتي أتهيدهيكل - Aravindante Athidhikal
programme.desc: ‫‫يتولى مالك فندق رعاية الصبي أرافيندان البالغ من العمر خمس سنوات بعد أن تتخلى عنه والدته في معبد. على الرغم من كل الصعوبات، يتمسك أرافيندان بأمل ينطوي على لم شمله مع والدته.‬‬ After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.

programme.title: بابي أباتشا - Paappi Appacha
programme.desc: ‫‫تجمع علاقة طيبة بين والد وابنه على الرغم من شخصية الوالد اللئيمة، إذ يقترفان العديد من الأشياء السيئة معا. عندما تقف في وجههما امرأةٌ شجاعة من القرية، يسبب ذلك مشاكل كبيرة ويجبر الأب والابن على الافتراق.‬‬ A mean father and son are close friends who do mean things together. When a brave village woman stands up to them, it causes big problems and forces the dad and son to split up.

programme.title: مودهوغافو - Mudhugavu
programme.desc: ‫‫تتداخل ثلاث قصص في هذا الفيلم، قصة حب ناشئة بين الطلاب، وقصة شريرة مرعبة، ومغامرات صديقين، والتي تبلغ ذروتها في حبكة آسرة.‬‬ Bharath, a technical student, has a strange habit that causes trouble for him and the people around him on several occasions.

programme.title: كابتن - Captain
programme.desc: ‫‫يمر في. بي. ساثيان وهو لاعب كرة قدم هندي محترف بالعديد من التقلبات في حياته خلال مسيرته المهنية بينما يسعى جاهدا لتحقيق طموحاته.‬‬ V. P. Sathyan, a professional Indian footballer, goes through various ups and devastating downs in his career as he strives hard to fulfil his ambitions.

programme.title: أورو يامندان بريما كادا - Oru Yamandan Premakadha
programme.desc: ‫‫لالو شخص سعيد الحظ يحب التسكع مع أصدقائه ويسعى وراء الحب الحقيقي. في أحد الأيام، يجد صورة لامرأة مفقودة تدعى ديا في الصحيفة ويشعر أن قلبه بدأ يخفق حبا.‬‬ Lallu, a happy-go-lucky person who loves to hang out with his friends, is in pursuit of true love. One day, he finds a photo of a missing woman, Diya, in the newspaper and feels a spark.

programme.title: Rappakal
programme.desc: ‫‫تعامل كبيرةإحدىالعائلات النبيلة ساراسويتياما خادمها كريشنان كأحد أبنائها. تتحد مع كريشنان لإنقاذ منزلها عندما يقرر أقرباؤها بيعه.‬‬ Saraswathiyamma is the head of a noble family that treats her servant Krishnan as one of her own sons. When her relatives conspire to sell her house, she and Krishnan set out to save it.

programme.title: لوسيفر - Lucifer
programme.desc: ‫‫عندما يموت زعيم حزب حاكم، ينشأ صراع على السلطة لتولي منصبه. يقوم ابنه بالتبني ستيفن الغامض باتخاذ خطوة ومواجهة تحديات في جميع ميادين الحياة.‬‬ The demise of the leader of a political party leads to a massive power struggle. Amidst the chaos, a mystical man named Stephen comes in to ascend the throne.

programme.title: ثونديموثالوم دريكساكشيوم - Thondimuthalum Driksakshiyum
programme.desc: ‫‫يناضل العروسان سريجا وبراساد من أجل التعامل مع الحياة الجديدة، ويقرران بيع سلسلة سريجا الذهبية. يسرق لص السلسلة أثناء رحلتها على متن حافلة، مما يزيد مشاكلهما.‬‬ Newly-weds Sreeja and Prasad struggle to cope with their lives and decide to sell Sreeja's gold chain for money. However, a thief steals the chain during a bus journey, adding to their woes.

programme.title: دريشيام ٢ - Drishyam 2
programme.desc: ‫‫يمتلك جورجكوتي صاحب المزاج المتقلب دار سينما خاصة به، ويحاول تحقيقي النجاح في حياته بطريقة باهرة. مع ذلك، عندما تتورط عائلته في تحقيق جنائي، يجب عليه حمايتها من المؤسسة القانونية.‬‬ Georgekutty, a cinema hall owner, is a changed man who thrives in life. However, when his family become entangled in a criminal investigation, he must protect them from the legal institution.

programme.title: أودهارامان سوجاتا - Udhaharanam Sujatha
programme.desc: ‫‫تشعر الأم العزباء سوجاثا التي تكافح من أجل تلبية احتياجاتها بخيبة أمل عندما تقرر ابنتها أثيرا ترك المدرسة، فتضع سوجاثا خطة لتحفيز ابنتها على الدراسة.‬‬ Sujatha, a single mother who struggles to make ends meet, is disappointed when her daughter Athira decides to drop out of school. So Sujatha devises a plan to motivate her to study.

programme.title: بن جونسون - Ben Johnson
programme.desc: ‫‫يترعرع جونسون في قرية موذانيوكوجا ويتطلع إلى تحقيق ما وصل إليه والده باثروز. يحلم أن يصبح شرطيا ويتفوق في ألعاب القوى، إذ يطلق عليه القرويين اسم بن جونسون.‬‬ Johnson, the honourable son of a dreaded local thug, decides to erase the bad image of his father in the society. He becomes a police officer and fights to bring criminals to justice.

programme.title: تشيس - Chess
programme.desc: ‫‫يقتل رجل شقيق زوجته الغني بمساعدة ثلاثة رجال متآمرين لجمع ثروته، وكما ينجح أيضا بتشويه سمعة الابن غير الشرعي للرجل المتوفى.‬‬ A man murders his rich brother-in-law with the help of three co-conspirators to amass his wealth. He also manages to discredit the deceased man's illegitimate son.

programme.title: سبيديكم - Spadikam
programme.desc: ‫‫لا يفرح رب العمل ومدير المدرسة تشاكو بابنه توماس أبدا، بل ودائما ما يسيء إليه. مع ذلك، بعد أن يسأم توماس من والده، يهرب من المنزل، لكنه يعود بعد فترة طويلة كرجل عصابة.‬‬ Chacko master, a school headmaster, is never happy with his son, Thomas, and always degrades him. However, having had enough of him, Thomas runs away from home only to return as a gangster after long.

programme.title: ذا بريست - The Priest
programme.desc: ‫‫يتعاون القسيس الأب كارمن مع الشرطة للتحقيق في سلسلة من قضايا الانتحار الغامضة. رغم ذلك، سرعان ما يكتشف حقيقة مثيرة للقلق ينتج عنها عواقب وخيمة.‬‬ Father Carmen, a priest, joins hands with the police to investigate a series of mysterious suicides. However, he soon stumbles upon a disturbing fact that has serious consequences.

programme.title: غاد فاذر - God Father
programme.desc: ‫‫يقرر أبناء أنجوران عدم الزواج نظرا لكره والدهم الشديد للنساء. مع ذلك، يتغير كل شيء عندما يقع ابن أنجوران الأصغر رامابهادران في حب مالو التي تعد جدتها ألد عدوة لعائلته.‬‬ Since Anjooran hates women, his sons remain unmarried. However, everything changes when his youngest son, Ramabhadran, falls in love with Malu, whose grandmother is their family's biggest enemy.

programme.title: سانديسام - Sandesam
programme.desc: ‫‫يعود راغافان ناير الذي كان يعمل مدير محطة وبلغ سن التقاعد إلى منزله لقضاء بعض الوقت مع زوجته وأطفاله. تأخذ الأمور منعطفا آخر عندما تحدث خلافات ابنه السياسية شرخا في العائلة.‬‬ Raghavan Nair, a retired station master, returns home to spend time with his wife and children. Things take a turn when his son's political differences create a rift in the family.

programme.title: غوروفايور أمبالانادايل - Guruvayur Ambalanadayil
programme.desc: ‫‫ينتظر شاب زفافه بفارغ الصبر، إلا أن القدر يقلب الأمور رأسا على عقب ليجد نفسه مرتبطا بامرأة قلبها مليء بمشاعر الاستياء تجاهه.‬‬ A young man eagerly awaits his wedding, but fate twists cruelly, forcing him into a lifelong bond with a woman who harbours nothing but resentment for him.

programme.title: ترافك - Traffic
programme.desc: ‫‫تسافر مجموعة متباينة من أبطال غير محتملين من مدينة مومباي إلى بوني بواسطة مركبة رباعية الدفع، حيث يسابقون الوقت لتوصيل قلب إلى مريض يبلغ من العمر ١٣ عاما.‬‬ Travelling from Mumbai to Pune in a four-wheeler, a motley crew of unlikely heroes must race against time to deliver a heart to a 13-year-old patient.

programme.title: بومارام - Poomaram
programme.desc: ‫‫تشارك كليتان في مهرجان للشباب. يمثل غوتامان كلية ماهاراجا، بينما تمثل إيرين كلية سانت تيريزا التي تحظى بالفوز دائما.‬‬ Two colleges participate in a youth festival. Gauthaman represents Maharaja college whereas Irene represents all-time winners, St Teresa's College.

programme.title: إميننالورل - Immini Nalloral
programme.desc: ‫‫جيفان معجب كثيرا بالممثلة المشهورة سنيها، وعندما تصل إلى قريته لتصوير فيلم، يظن جيفان أنهما متزوجان بالفعل، فيقوم باختطافها.‬‬ Jeevan is a huge fan of Sneha, a popular actress and when she arrives in his village for a movie shoot, the former is under the illusion that they are already married and kidnaps her.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح745 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E745 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: ماهابهارات - Mahabharatham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح267 : ‫يؤدي صراع سلالي بين الفروع الجانبية لعشيرة كورو، وهما بكورافاس وباندافاس على عرش هاستينابور إلى حرب كوروكشترا.‬‬ S1 , E267 : A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.

programme.title: جونيور سينيور - Junior Senior
programme.desc: ‫‫يقع رجل في حب فتاة ويدرك أن صديقه لن يوافق على هذه العلاقة، فيقوم بإرسال بطاقة معايدة وهمية لصديقه متظاهرا بأنها من الفتاة. تتطور الأمور عندما يقع صديق الرجل في حب نفس الفتاة.‬‬ A rich man is a coquette who lures women into his trap for his selfish desires. One of his employees gets compelled to fight him when he sees his employer trying the same trick to woo his girlfriend.

programme.title: أوثيكاتشيا بونو - Oothikachiya Ponnu
programme.desc: ‫‬ Struggling saleswoman Sukumari's life transforms after a chance encounter with wealthy businessman Vishwanathan, offering unexpected opportunities.

programme.title: أوركابوراثو - Orkkapurathu
programme.desc: ‫‫يحاول السمساران فريدي ونيكولاس بشتى الطرق كسب المال من أجل استرجاع سفينتهما من رجل أعمال، لكنهما يقعان في مأزق عندما يلجآن إلى طرق غير مشروعة للحصول على المال.‬‬ Brokers, Freddy and Nicholas, try various ways to make money to repossess their boat from a businessman. However, they get into trouble when they resort to illegal ways to earn money.

programme.title: ماليكبورام - Malikappuram
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح1 : ‫عندما يقوم أقارب وأهالي مجتمع الطفلة أونيمول بطردها، يتخذ اللورد أيابان شكل طالب مدرسة لمساعدتها في التغلب على العقبات.‬‬ S1 , E1 : Unnimol is a fervent worshipper of Lord Ayyappa. However, she struggles to deal with her family, who avoids her.

programme.title: إيتو جانما كالبانيل - Eatho Janma Kalpanayil
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح171 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة المرحة سروثي والتي تنتمي من عائلة متواضعة صدفة برجل الأعمال الثري المتغطرس أشوين، وسرعان ما ينشأ الحب بينهما.‬‬ S1 , E171 : Love blooms between Sruthy, a cheerful girl from a humble background and Ashwin, an arrogant wealthy businessman when they accidentally come across each other.

programme.title: تشاندريكايل أليونو تشاندراكانتام - Chandrikayil Aliyunnu Chandrakantham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح172 : ‫يتزوج ضابط الشرطة غوتام من الطبيبة الطموحة ألاكاناندا رغما عنه، لكن عندما تعود حبيبته الأولى إلى حياته، يجبر على الاختيار بين ماضيه ومستقبله.‬‬ S1 , E172 : Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.

programme.title: توفالسبارشام - Thoovalsparsham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح171 : ‫تتفرق شقيقتان في طفولتهما إثر جريمة قتل تقع في العائلة. بينما تكبر إحداهما لتصبح ضابطة شرطة، تسلك الأخرى طريق الجرائم الصغيرة لكسب عيشها.‬‬ S1 , E171 : Two sisters are separated during their childhood due to a murder in the family. While one becomes a police officer, the other turns to petty crime for a living.

programme.title: باداتا بينكيلي - Paadatha Painkili
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح171 : ‫تواجه امرأة شابة عذابا وقمعا مستمرا من عائلتها المتشددة، لكنها تظل صامدة في بحثها عن الحب والسعادة وتصمم على ذلك.‬‬ S1 , E171 : A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح746 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E746 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح91 : ‫تعيش سريديفي حياة هانئة وسعيدة مع زوجها بالاكريشنان وأشقائه، لكن تواجه العائلة العديد من المصاعب التي تحد من علاقتها الوثيقة.‬‬ S1 , E91 : Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. programme.title: ماليكبورام - Malikappuram
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح4 : ‫عندما يقوم أقارب وأهالي مجتمع الطفلة أونيمول بطردها، يتخذ اللورد أيابان شكل طالب مدرسة لمساعدتها في التغلب على العقبات.‬‬ S1 , E4 : When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.

programme.title: إيتو جانما كالبانيل - Eatho Janma Kalpanayil
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح174 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة المرحة سروثي والتي تنتمي من عائلة متواضعة صدفة برجل الأعمال الثري المتغطرس أشوين، وسرعان ما ينشأ الحب بينهما.‬‬ S1 , E174 : Love blooms between Sruthy, a cheerful girl from a humble background and Ashwin, an arrogant wealthy businessman when they accidentally come across each other.

programme.title: تشاندريكايل أليونو تشاندراكانتام - Chandrikayil Aliyunnu Chandrakantham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح175 : ‫يتزوج ضابط الشرطة غوتام من الطبيبة الطموحة ألاكاناندا رغما عنه، لكن عندما تعود حبيبته الأولى إلى حياته، يجبر على الاختيار بين ماضيه ومستقبله.‬‬ S1 , E175 : Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.

programme.title: توفالسبارشام - Thoovalsparsham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح174 : ‫تتفرق شقيقتان في طفولتهما إثر جريمة قتل تقع في العائلة. بينما تكبر إحداهما لتصبح ضابطة شرطة، تسلك الأخرى طريق الجرائم الصغيرة لكسب عيشها.‬‬ S1 , E174 : Two sisters are separated during their childhood due to a murder in the family. While one becomes a police officer, the other turns to petty crime for a living.

programme.title: باداتا بينكيلي - Paadatha Painkili
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح174 : ‫تواجه امرأة شابة عذابا وقمعا مستمرا من عائلتها المتشددة، لكنها تظل صامدة في بحثها عن الحب والسعادة وتصمم على ذلك.‬‬ S1 , E174 : A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح749 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E749 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح94 : ‫تعيش سريديفي حياة هانئة وسعيدة مع زوجها بالاكريشنان وأشقائه، لكن تواجه العائلة العديد من المصاعب التي تحد من علاقتها الوثيقة.‬‬ S1 , E94 : Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.

programme.title: موناراغم - Mounaragam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح1622 : ‫تعاني كالياني من ضعف في النطق وجميع أفراد عائلتها يكرهونها باستثناء والدتها. وبينما تتوق إلى حنان والدها، يدخل كيران حياتها.‬‬ S1 , E1622 : Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.

programme.title: غيثا غوفيندام - Geetha Govindam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح80 : ‫يواجه رجل أعمال في منتصف العمر أعزب ماضيه الغامض، مما يؤثر على علاقته الرومانسية الاستثنائية بشابة تصغره في السن.‬‬ S1 , E80 : When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.

programme.title: نمال - Nammal
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح2 : ‫تابع قصة ستة شباب وهم يتنقلون بين السعادة وقلوب منفطرة وجميع التحديات بمختلف المستويات التي تلقيها الحياة في طريقهم.‬‬ S1 , E2 : Follow the story of six youngsters as they navigate through happiness, heartbreaks and all the challenges that life throws at them.

programme.title: دهانام - Dhanam
programme.desc: ‫‫يكشف ناير وصديقه خطط بعض المهربين السرية ويقرران إخبار السلطات بالمعلومات الخطيرة مقابل مبلغ قيمته عشرين ألف روبية. تتصاعد الأحداث عندما يدرك المهربون ذلك، ويبدؤون بملاحقتهما.‬‬ Sivasankar and his friend overhear the plans of a group of smugglers. To earn a reward, they alert the customs department, resulting in the smuggler, who has lost his money, to pursue them.

programme.title: فارون دكتور - Doctor
programme.desc: ‫‫عندما يتعقب طبيب عسكري أثر ابنة خطيبته السابقة المختطفة، يكتشف شبكة معقدة للاتجار بالبشر في ولاية غوا، ثم ينصب فخا محكما للقبض على الجناة.‬‬ When a military doctor tracks down his former fiancee's kidnapped niece, he discovers a complex human trafficking ring in Goa. He then weaves an intricate trap to capture the perpetrators.

programme.desc: بعد وفاة ناديا زوجة أبي عصام الثانية، وانكشاف قصة تجنيدها في الجيش الفرنسي، تتوالى المشاكل على رأس أبي عصام، وخصوصاً بعد ظهور قصة حب بين شاب وفتاة والتي من شأنها أن تشعل فتيل الصراعات، ترى هل سيتمكن أبو عصام من الصمود في وجه تلك التحديات؟ After the death of Abu Issam’s second wife Nadia, and the fact that she was recruited by the French army, problems pile up on Abu Issam as a love story between a young man and a young woman threatens to ruin everything.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi

Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished. In the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. With time, Corban became more than a religious festival. It developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar. Corban is as important as New Year. Kashgar locals load their tables with food on this day to reward themselves for a year of hard work. Corban is all about sharing. In the past, rich families would buy extra meat to share with their neighbors and friends. This tradition is still alive in Kashgar today, although it’s practiced not just by the rich, but pretty well everyone.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc: Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port. With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads. In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites. Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض عدد من المحللين والخبراء الماليين تحليلاتهم المفصلة، كما ويناقشون آخر الأخبار والتطورات في السوق.‬‬ Financial analysts and experts provide their in-depth analysis and discuss the latest news and developments of the market.

programme.title: مسار السوق - Masar Al Souq
programme.desc: ‫‫تقوم مجموعة من المحللين بتسليط الضوء على آخر الأخبار والتطورات التي تتعلق بالسوق المالية في العالم العربي.‬‬ Analysts shed light on the latest news updates and developments related to the financial market of the Arab world.

programme.title: بورصات العالم - Borsaat Al A'alam
programme.desc: ‫‫يدعو المضيف عددا من الخبراء من أجل الحديث عن خبراتهم وتحليلاتهم لآخر الأخبار والتطورات في عالم الأموال والاقتصاد.‬‬ The host invites experts to share their knowledge and analysis of the latest news updates and developments in the world of finance and economics.

programme.title: في العمق - Fi Al O'mq
programme.desc: ‫‫يحاور المضيف شخصيات وخبراء ماليين بارزين لمناقشة مختلف جوانب سوق الأوراق المالية، والمستجدات المتعلقة بأكبر الشركات في العالم بدقة.‬‬ The host interviews prominent personalities and financial experts to thoroughly discuss various aspects of the stock market and updates regarding the world's largest corporations.

programme.title: كريبتو ويكلي - Crypto Weekly
programme.desc: ‫‫مجموعة شاملة ومتنوعة من آخر الأخبار والمستجدات والتطورات التي تدور حول العملات المشفرة في مختلف أنحاء العالم.‬‬ A comprehensive compilation of the latest news, updates and developments revolving around cryptocurrencies from around the world.

programme.title: لايف - Live
programme.desc: ‫‬ Live

programme.title: سي إي أو توكس - CEO Talks
programme.desc: ‫‫تقوم المضيفة بدعوة رؤساء تنفيذيين بارزين من جميع أنحاء العالم لمناقشة مجموعة من المواضيع وتسليط الضوء على تجاربهم الشخصية في مجالات اختصاصهم.‬‬ The host invites prominent CEOs from around the world to discuss an array of topics and highlight their experiences in their respective fields.

programme.title: دبل كليك - Double Click
programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض المضيف آخر الأخبار والموضوعات المنتشرة على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، خلال مناقشة تأثيراتها الرئيسية على عالم الأعمال والاقتصاد.‬‬ The host presents the latest news and trending topics on social media platforms while discussing their major effects on the world of business and economy.

programme.title: بموضوعية - Bi Mawdouiyeh
programme.desc: ‫‫يدعو المضيف عددا من الخبراء البارزين من أجل الحديث عن تحليلاتهم المفصلة فيما يتعلق بمختلف القضايا في عالم الاقتصاد العربي.‬‬ The host invites notable experts to provide their in-depth analysis of the goings-on and various issues in the Arab economy.

programme.title: وثائقي - Wathaeqi
programme.desc: ‫‫يسلط صانع الأفلام الضوء على مجموعة من الأحداث المهمة والقضايا الجدلية والأحداث الرائدة من حول العالم.‬‬ The filmmaker sheds light on an array of significant events around the world to bring several controversial issues to light.

programme.title: شيفرة المال - Shefrat Al Mal
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم المضيف بدعوة خبراء لمناقشة مجموعة من المواضيع التي تدور حول الشؤون المالية والاستثمار، بهف تبسيط القواعد الأسياسية للاستثمار ومساعدة المشاهدين على فهم كيفية التعامل مع المال بطريقة أفضل.‬‬ The host invites experts to discuss various topics revolving around finances and investments to simplify the ground rules of investing and help the viewers better understand how to deal with money.

programme.title: تحت الضوء - Taht Al Dhaw'
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم المضيف بتسليط الضوء على أحدث الأخبار والتطورات والمستجدات المالية من أنحاء العالم، أثناء تفاعله مع مختلف الخبراء.‬‬ The host sheds light on the most recent financial news, updates and developments from across the globe while interacting with various experts.

programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض الفريق الإخباري آخر الأخبار والمستجدات والتقارير فيما يتعلق بمختلف القضايا السياسية والاقتصادية وغيرها من الشؤون الجارية حول العالم.‬‬ Anchors present the latest news, updates and reports on an array of political, economic and various other matters and current affairs around the world.

programme.desc:
Big City Greens S1
Cricket gleder seg til sin første halloween i storbyen. Han og Tilly regner med å innkassere mye mer godteri enn de noen gang klarte da de gikk knask-eller-knep på landet! Blood Moon Part 1/ Blood Moon Part 2
Cricket is excited for his first Halloween in Big City, where he and Tilly expect to collect way more candy than they ever got Trick-or-Treating in the country!

programme.title: هامستر وغريتل الموسم الثاني - Hamster & Gretel: Season 2
programme.desc:
البحث عن (سوبر غاي) / (لوراين) والغيتار القديم
السيدة (نايت) معلّمة الصحافة الجديدة، تشجّع (هيرومي) على إيجاد (سوبر غاي).وعمة (نوردل) تُسحَب إلى عالم آخر في حفل عيد ميلاده. The Search for Super Guy/ Lorraine, Rattle, and Roll
Ms. Night, the new journalism teacher, encourages Hiromi to find Super Guy; Nordle's aunt is sucked into an alternate universe at his birthday party.

Dave is mistaken for a secret agent while on a train ride with his family; Fred takes over as president when Chad Goldenboy goes missing.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
من أجل الثلج فقط / عام جديد سعيد!
في الجزء الأول، "جيرمي" يؤمن بأن "سندس" معجبة بالهوكي، مما يدفع "سندس" و"زهرة" لتعلم اللعبة. في هذه الأثناء، "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران نسخة جديدة من لعبة الهوكي، لكي تُلعب أثناء استراحة المباراة، و"بيري" يحاول إيقاف "أبو الأشرار" من تطوير جهاز شرير، والذي سيحول الهدف إلى شيء أكبر وأكثر إخافة من هيئته الأساسية. / في الجزء الثاني، "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران نوعًا من الكرات والذي سيسيقط من الفضاء حين منتصف الليل في عشية السنة الجديدة. "سندس" تقرر قرارًا للعام الجديد بأن تكف عن النيل من أخويها لكن لديها ساعة كاملة قبل أن ينتهي العام من أجل الوصل إلى هدفها. في هذه الأثناء، "بيري" يحاول إيقاف "أبو الأشرار" من التلاعب بقرارات السنة الجديدة لسكان بلدة "دانفيل". For Your Ice Only/ Happy New Year!
In the first segment, Jeremy believes Candace to be a hockey fan, prompting Candace and Stacy to go to elaborate lengths to learn about the game. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb devise an exciting new version of hockey, to be played during the break of a local hockey game, and Perry sets out to stop Doctor Doofenshmirtz from developing "The Abonimable-inator," which would transform its target into a bigger and scarier version of itself./In the second segment, Phineas and Ferb devise a type of ball that will drop from space at the stroke of midnight on New Year's Eve. Candace has made a New Year's resolution to stop trying to bust her brothers, but still has a whole hour before the year is over to accomplish her goal. Meanwhile, Perry tries to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from manipulating the New Year's resolutions of the people of Danville.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
إخفاق "بولي" / حساء الفناء الخلفي
في الجزء الأول، "سندس" تتحدى "فؤاد" في النيل من أخويها عن طريق عدم اختفاء اختراعهما اليومي لكي تراه الأم. في هذه الأثناء، الولدان يحتفلان بالنظافة ببناء كرة تنظيف أسناس كبيرة، و"أبو الأشرار" يشرب الكثير من الكافيين. في الجزء الثاني، "فارس" يحاول إيجاد حل لمخلفات اختراعاته السابقة، والذي يجعل المجموعة تبني وعاءً للاختراعات. في هذه الأثناء، الأم تواجه مشاكلًا في النوم أثناء إعدادها لفطائر من أجل حدث، و"أبو الأشرار" يحاول أن يسبب العمى للبدلة بأكملها. Bully Bust/ Backward Hodge Podge
In the first segment, Candace challenges Buford to take on the task of busting her brothers by making sure that their daily invention doesn't disappear just as Mom is about to see it. Meanwhile, the boys celebrate oral hygiene by building a giant Dental Hygienoshpere, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz consumes too much caffeine. In the second segment, Phineas tries to figure out what to do with the leftover materials from past inventions and big ideas, which leads to the gang building an "invention casserole." Meanwhile, Mom fights some serious sleep deprivation while baking pies for an event, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz attempts to temporarily blind the entire Tri-State area.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"دير كيندرلامبر" / الحلويات فقط
يبتكر الأخوان عربات "روباتاغا" حينما تصبح "سندس" أميرة "روباتاغا" والتي ستبدأ سباق "التشينشيلاز". في الجهة المقابلة للبلدة، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لتحويل نفسه إلى "كيندر لامبر" حقيقي لإخافة "روجر" من السيطرة على البلدة عوضًا عنه. / "سندس" تتطوع لمساعدة "جميلة" في تسجيل كتابها الصوتي لكي تتيح الفرصة للأخوين لبناء مشروع تسلق الصخور. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يبتكر جهاز إحضار الحلوى والذي يجعل الناس يتوقفون عما يفعلون ويحضرون الحلوى. Der Kinderlumper/ Just Desserts
The boys create Rutabaga-themed vehicles when Candace is chosen to be Rutabaga princess and gets to start the "Running of the Chinchillas." Across town, Doofenshmirtz plans to turn himself into a real live Kinderlumper to scare Roger into relinquishing control of the Tri-State Area over to him./ Candace volunteers to help Isabella record her audio book so the boys can continue building their giant, recyclable, rock climbing project as planned, and get busted by mom. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz creates a Bring-Out-Dessert-Inator which gets people to interrupt what they’re doing and bring out dessert.

تواجه "هيرومي" و"فريد" رجالاً آليين في المدرسة،أغنية دعائية جديدة لحبوب الإفطار في التلفاز تنوّم الناس مغناطيسياً. Friday Night Fright/ The Earworm
Hiromi and Fred encounter robots at the school; A new breakfast cereal TV jingle hypnotizes people.

Gretel’s science project goes wrong; Strange things start to happen when the elementary school rehearses for a play.

كيف تحتاج إلى أن تعطس/صندوق البريد
كيف لديها عطسة محبوسة في داخل رأسها لذا هي وباري يحاولان إخراجها. كيف وباري يقابلان ممثلهما المفضل لكن لا يعجبهما؟ Kiff Has to Sneeze/ Never Meet Your Mailboxes

Kiff, Barry, and Trevor sneak into a movie and try not to get caught. Martin and Beryl vie for Kiff's favor when Kiff comes into some money.

عندما يصنع كريكت وتيلي انطباعاً أولياً خاطئاً، ينسيان من يكونان حقاً. كريكت وتيلي يأخذان وأين في جولة في المدينة ليعبر عن تحمسه الحقيقي Locked In/ City Wayne
When Cricket and Tilly make a bad first impression, they forget who they truly are. Cricket and Tilly take Wayne on a tour of Big City so he can experience true excitement.

programme.desc:

Tilly gets caught up in the world of make-believe when she sets out to help Saxon find true love. Remy's parents try to build a stronger relationship with their son.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
كابرا "سندس" / عيد مولد سعيد يا "جميلة"
الولدان يحاولان إثبات وجود "تشوباكابرا" للعالم، لكن "سندس" لا يمكنها الانتظار وتصبح بحاجة إلى كشفه أولًا للأم. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" لديه فكرة عبقرية لاستخدام جهاز تبديل المكان لإزالة الشعر من شخص وإعطائه لشخص آخر لكي يحاول بيع مستحضر تطويل الشعر. / "فارس" والمجموعة يحتفلان بيوم ميلاد "جميلة" بطريقة كبيرة، لكنها تريد وقت هادئ مع "فارس" فحسب. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" وضع جهاز "الإزعاج" في حافلة حشرة شريرة والتي تسير في أنحاء "دانفيل" وتحول كل من يزعجه إلى حشرة. La Candace-Cabra/ Happy Birthday, Isabella
The boys set out to prove the existence of the elusive Chupacabra to the world, but Candace can’t stand the wait and needs to first just prove it to Mom. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has the brilliant idea to use his Switch-Place-Inator to remove hair from one person and give it to another so that he can in turn sell his hair growing tonic./ Phineas and the gang celebrate Isabella’s birthday in a big way, but all she really wants is some quiet time with Phineas. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has installed his Bugs Me-Inator onto an evil bug bus and is driving around Danville turning all the things that bug him literally into bugs.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
كرات ماء كبيرة / أين "بينكي"؟
حينما تعتقد "سندس" أن "سامي" قد أصيب بالملل في مقابلتهما، تحاول فعل شيء خاص معه. في هذه الأثناء، "فارس" و"فادي" يسبحان ف البلدة على كرة كبيرة من الماء، و"أبو الأشرار" يخطط لاستخدام جهاز النفي المزدوج للحصول على شراب شتوي والذي لا يُقدم إلى في الصيف. / حينما يصبح "بينكي" مفقودًا، "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان آلة والتي ستساعد "فؤاد" في إيجاد كلبه. رغم ذلك، الآلة تخرج عن السيطرة وتضع هويات الحيوانات السرية في خطر. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تحاول مقابلة "سامي" للغداء في مبنى البلدة لكنها تصبح عالقة في جولة إلزامية. Great Balls of Water/ Where's Pinky?
When Candace thinks Jeremy is bored with their usual hangouts, she sets out to find something unique to do with him. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb power through town surfing on a giant ball of water and Doofenshmirtz plans to use his Double-Negative-Inator to confuse his local eatery into giving him a wintery drink that is usually not served during summer./ When Pinky goes missing, Phineas " Ferb create a machine that will amplify Buford's senses to those of a dog's. However, it works so well that the animal agents' secret identities are put in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Candace tries to meet up with Jeremy for lunch at City Hall but gets stuck in a mandatory tour.

Spider-Man, Iron Man, Thor and Hulk stand powerless after being struck by Dr. Doofenshmirtz's power-draining inator. Once the Marvel Super Villains – Red Skull, Whiplash, Venom and M.O.D.O.K. – find out that Dr. Doofenshmirtz is responsible for robbing the Super Heroes of their powers, they seek him out and together create mayhem in Danville. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb do everything they can to restore the Super Heroes' powers before the evil villains take over the world.

في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. Climatiqueen
Adrien is worried he doesn't have a passion. Marinette decides to do everything she can to help him find one. Too busy devoting tremendous energy to her task, she doesn't see that someone is watching them, someone who wants to use Adrien's popularity to indulge their own passion... And the arrival of a supervillain determined to steal Ladybug and Cat Noir’s thunder is about to make things worse!

"بيري" البدائي
حينما يواجه "بيري" صياد خلد ماء إستراليًا والذي يحاول النيل منه، تصبح حياته في خطر ويجب عليه إيجاد طريقة للتغلب على عدوه، وإنقاذ "أبو الأشرار" من أخطائه. في هذه الأثناء، "بخيت" يصبح لديه حالة طارئة ويجد نفسه عاجزًا عن اتخاذ القرارات، لذلك "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران مولّد احتمالات والذي سيساعد "بخيت" في اتخاذ القرارات دون عواقب. Primal Perry (Part 1 and 2)
When Perry comes face to face with an Australian platypus hunter named Liam set out on destroying him, his unwavering demeanor is threatened and his life is put in danger -- he must find a way to defeat this villainous foe, rescue Doofenshmirtz from the error of his ways and save himself from the hunt. Meanwhile, Baljeet is having an existential emergency and finds himself incapable of making decisions, so Phineas and Ferb create an infinite probability generator that will allow Baljeet to make as many choices as he pleases without being affected by the consequences.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
كابرا "سندس" / عيد مولد سعيد يا "جميلة"
الولدان يحاولان إثبات وجود "تشوباكابرا" للعالم، لكن "سندس" لا يمكنها الانتظار وتصبح بحاجة إلى كشفه أولًا للأم. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" لديه فكرة عبقرية لاستخدام جهاز تبديل المكان لإزالة الشعر من شخص وإعطائه لشخص آخر لكي يحاول بيع مستحضر تطويل الشعر. / "فارس" والمجموعة يحتفلان بيوم ميلاد "جميلة" بطريقة كبيرة، لكنها تريد وقت هادئ مع "فارس" فحسب. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" وضع جهاز "الإزعاج" في حافلة حشرة شريرة والتي تسير في أنحاء "دانفيل" وتحول كل من يزعجه إلى حشرة. La Candace-Cabra/ Happy Birthday, Isabella
The boys set out to prove the existence of the elusive Chupacabra to the world, but Candace can’t stand the wait and needs to first just prove it to Mom. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has the brilliant idea to use his Switch-Place-Inator to remove hair from one person and give it to another so that he can in turn sell his hair growing tonic./ Phineas and the gang celebrate Isabella’s birthday in a big way, but all she really wants is some quiet time with Phineas. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has installed his Bugs Me-Inator onto an evil bug bus and is driving around Danville turning all the things that bug him literally into bugs.
